keyEvents.text: Goal! Benfica 1, Lech Poznań 0. Rafa (Benfica) right footed shot from very close range to the bottom right corner.
Yannick Agnero (Lech Poznań) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Daniel Banjaqui (Benfica) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Benfica 1, Lech Poznań 0.
Manu Silva (Benfica) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Lech Poznań. Luis Palma replaces Daniel Håkans.
Substitution, Benfica. Gianluca Prestianni replaces Rafa.
Substitution, Benfica. Enzo Barrenechea replaces Manu Silva.
Substitution, Benfica. Fredrik Aursnes replaces Claudio Echeverri.
Goal! Benfica 2, Lech Poznań 0. Gianluca Prestianni (Benfica) left footed shot from a difficult angle on the left to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Heorhiy Sudakov.
Substitution, Benfica. João Palhinha replaces Tomás Araújo.
Substitution, Lech Poznań. Filip Jagiello replaces Pablo Rodríguez because of an injury.
Substitution, Lech Poznań. Leo Bengtsson replaces Patrik Wålemark.
Substitution, Lech Poznań. Gustav Berggren replaces Antoni Kozubal.
Goal! Benfica 2, Lech Poznań 1. Leo Bengtsson (Lech Poznań) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the high centre of the goal.
Delay in match (Benfica).
Substitution, Lech Poznań. Robert Gumny replaces Joel Pereira.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Benfica. Dodi Lukébakio replaces Andreas Schjelderup.
Goal! Benfica 3, Lech Poznań 1. Heorhiy Sudakov (Benfica) right footed shot from the left side of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Enzo Barrenechea following a fast break.
